data.name: Gurdeepika
data.gender_notes: Gurdeepika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gains deep knowledge from the guru, a spiritual guide and mentor. In Hinduism, the guru is considered a bridge between the individual and the divine. The name Gurdeepika carries the meaning “Deep learning from the Guru” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gurdeepika usually hope their child will grow to embody deep learning from the guru and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant seeker of wisdom and knowledge from the spiritual guide.
data.etymology: Gurdeepika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deep learning from the Guru.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurdeepika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Gurdeepika" symbolizes the inner light of knowledge and wisdom that one gains from their guru.
